title: Making friends
text: A Make a name card on page 85.
B Greet your friend and talk about your names.
He Chao: Good morning. I'm He Chao. What's your name?
Chen Fan: Good morning, He Chao. My name is Chen Fan.
He Chao: Nice to meet you, Chen Fan.
Chen Fan: Nice to meet you too.
